---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a user-facing capability with acceptance criteria
title: "[Feature] "
labels: ["type: feature"]
assignees: []
---

## User problem

Who needs this and what outcome do they need?

## Scope

What is in and out of scope?

## Requirements and acceptance criteria

- [ ] Given … when … then …

## Dependencies and contracts

List prerequisite issues, ADRs, API contracts, data migrations, or integrations.

## Security, rights, privacy, and operations

Describe relevant authorization, content-rights, personal-data, abuse, monitoring, and failure concerns.

## Verification and documentation

Specify automated tests, independent review, and docs to update. Do not mark done without evidence.
